description: QuickMind is an AI assistant for macOS and Windows that provides dictation, screen-aware assistance, meeting notes, and persistent personal memory. It can also connect to services like Google and expose a read-only connector so other AI apps can access a user's QuickMind notes and memory.
summary: QuickMind exposes one documented developer integration surface: an OAuth-protected remote MCP server at `https://api.tryquickmind.com/mcp` for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and other MCP-capable apps; no public REST, GraphQL, or CLI surface was found.
